title: Automate CRD + API docs generation from Go types
description:
Replace hand-rolled CRDs (deploy/crds.yml) and API reference docs (docs/api.md) with generated artifacts sourced from Go API types under pkg/jetstream/apis.

Scope:
- Adopt common Kubernetes tooling (controller-gen for CRDs, gen-crd-api-reference-docs for docs).
- Move existing schema/docs text from deploy/crds.yml + docs/api.md into Go type comments and kubebuilder markers.
- Add Makefile targets + CI guardrails so artifacts stay in sync.

title: Add controller-gen + doc generator tooling
description:
Add pinned tool binaries (via Makefile go-install-tool) and new make targets:
- generate-crds: run controller-gen against API packages and write CRDs to a generated dir
- generate-docs: run gen-crd-api-reference-docs to produce docs/api.md
- ensure make generate includes these or document workflow

Acceptance:
- One-command regeneration for CRDs + docs.
- Tool versions pinned and reproducible.

title: Port Stream CRD schema/docs into Go markers
description:
For Stream (v1beta2 + v1beta1):
- Add kubebuilder markers for defaults/validation (patterns, enums, mins/maxes) matching deploy/crds.yml.
- Add field-level godoc comments sourced from existing CRD schema descriptions.
- Add kubebuilder resource markers (root object, status subresource, printer columns) to match current CRD behavior.

Acceptance:
- controller-gen output for Stream matches current hand-rolled schema (modulo ordering).
- docs generation includes the existing descriptions.

title: Port Consumer + StreamTemplate schema/docs into Go markers
description:
For Consumer (v1beta2 + v1beta1) and StreamTemplate (v1beta1):
- Mirror validations/defaults/descriptions from deploy/crds.yml into Go markers + comments.
- Ensure served/storage flags match current CRDs (v1beta1 served=false where applicable).

Acceptance:
- Generated CRDs align with current behavior for these resources.
- docs/api.md entries reflect migrated comments.

title: Port Account/KeyValue/ObjectStore schema/docs into Go markers
description:
For Account, KeyValue, ObjectStore (v1beta2):
- Transfer schema validations/defaults/descriptions from deploy/crds.yml into Go markers + comments.
- Add/verify printer columns and status subresource markers.

Acceptance:
- Generated CRDs validate the same constraints as current hand-rolled CRDs.

title: Wire generated CRDs/docs into deploy artifacts
description:
Update the repo layout/workflow so generated CRDs and docs are the source of truth:
- Decide generated output locations (e.g., config/crd/bases + deploy/crds.yml as concatenated artifact).
- Update kuttl-test.yaml to apply the generated CRDs artifact.
- Remove or clearly mark any remaining hand-rolled CRD sources.

title: Add sync/CI guardrails for generated artifacts
description:
Add a check that fails CI if CRDs/docs are out of date. Options:
- go test golden test that runs controller-gen and diffs artifacts, or
- make check-generate target used in CI.

Acceptance:
- Contributors can't accidentally drift CRD schema/docs from Go types.
